items.title: LOFTAPPS to Debut LOFT Software and Peek at Phil Tippett's 'Mad God' Sequel at VIEW 2026
items.rationale: New tool debut. LOFTAPPS gives its generative AI production OS its European premiere, and Phil Tippett shows a stop-motion 'Mad God' sequel made with it, a strong craft-meets-AI case.
items.excerpt: Berkeley company LOFTAPPS gives its generative AI production system a European premiere at VIEW 2026 in Turin (Oct 12-16), where Phil Tippett will share an exclusive look at his stop-motion 'Mad God' follow-up made with the LOFT OS.

items.title: YouTuber Gossip Goblin Releases Trailer For R-Rated AI Theatrical Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts'
items.rationale: Concrete release. This is the first trailer for an R-rated theatrical feature made entirely with AI, so viewers can now see what a fully AI-made feature looks like.
items.excerpt: YouTuber Gossip Goblin has released the trailer for 'Gods Don't Give Gifts,' an R-rated theatrical feature film made entirely with artificial intelligence.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA TV Animation Deal Boosts Wages, AI Protections
items.rationale: New labour agreement with expanded AI protections for voice performers, now going to a member vote. It directly changes the rules for AI voice use in TV animation.
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA members will vote on a new TV animation agreement featuring annual wage increases, expanded AI protections for voice performers, better residuals and benefit gains.

items.title: The Tools Shaping the Future of VFX
items.rationale: Practitioners name the specific ML/AI, real-time and cloud tools they expect to reshape shot-making, giving artists an actionable list to evaluate.
items.excerpt: VFX artists, supervisors and technologists across the VFX and AI ecosystem name the ML/AI, real-time, virtual production and cloud tools they believe will reshape how shots are made and who holds creative control.

items.title: The State of VFX and Animation Might Surprise You
items.rationale: A reality check on Katzenberg's 2023 forecast that AI would cut animation crews by 90% by 2026: it measures what AI has actually changed in VFX and animation staffing.
items.excerpt: Three years after Jeffrey Katzenberg predicted AI would shrink a 500-artist animated feature crew to under 50 by 2026, Joseph Bell checks how AI has actually changed VFX and animation staffing.
